newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire up on results, rosey outlook.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire up on results, rosey outlook.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Group Plc advanced to a five-week high on Monday after the UK specialty chemicals group posted better-than-expected results and an upbeat trading statement, market makers said.
By 1048 GMT, the shares were up 22p to 211.
The group said its pre-tax profits were 2.81 million stg for the year ended December 31, 1996 after an exceptional charge of 10.3 million stg.
Yorkshire said that trading got off to a good start in 1997, with sales volumes well above those recorded in the year ago period.
Additionally, dealers said the shares also were boosted by a report in the Sunday Telegraph, which tipped the stock as a buy. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
